description: Combined synthetic source events for a wired Catalyst Center client traversing Catalyst SD-WAN to a Cilium app on ACI and a bridged Meraki MR client observed by an MS390 exporting IPFIX to a separate Cilium app on NX-OS. Values are illustrative; no exporter or API collection is being asserted.
window_anchor: CLI --base-time anchors the source scenario's window.start; omitted means current UTC.

negative_cases.meaning: A flow without a matching Meraki association event stays an unresolved network client; no AP/SSID is filled in.
An association older than the configured evidence-age bound does not attach later flow.
Two simultaneously valid claims for one client MAC with incompatible IPs/scopes remain conflict evidence.
Two sequential type=association records for one client on AP-01 then AP-02 represent observed AP movement; no disassociation event is fabricated.
The same IP can be associated to different MAC identities at different observed event times; correlation is time bounded.
An identical raw association event may be received twice; event identity is based on stable raw evidence, not generated event IDs.
MS390 collection fields are best-effort and its documented record does not establish exporter sampling metadata; absent counters or sampling data stay unknown.
MS390 documents both input and output interface collection; records are observations, not independent connection counts, and counters from both views must not be summed blindly.
Without observed translated tuples or proxy/XFF/backend evidence, do not bridge client IP to a post-NAT, proxy-source, or tunneled inner tuple.

qualification_limits: Both cluster instances intentionally reuse Kubernetes display names and private service/pod addresses; cluster identity must remain in every Kubernetes/Hubble/OTel record.
Catalyst lastUpdatedTime is a controller snapshot-update timestamp; normalized attachment validity begins at Splunk receipt (_indextime). No synthetic collection timestamp is added.
Meraki association occurredAt is event time. The official example documents optional AP/client fields, but tenant responses and retention are not validated by this synthetic fixture.
MS390 flow values are a synthetic template-shaped example, not a captured exporter packet or validated Stream decoder output.
Catalyst SD-WAN fields are limited to names present in the verified 4.0.0 ipfixmap and Stream field definition; values and template activation are not live-validated.
The standard campus, SD-WAN, ACI, and MS390 flow records are distinct exporter observations of related traffic; they are not independent application connections or counters to add together.
The MS390 +180 second flow follows the +150 second association to MR-NXOS-02; the synthetic LLDP topology row places MR-NXOS-02 on switch port 11.
